points: None of your 21 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer in the feed has no reason to trust you over the next brand. Pick one proof number, such as orders shipped, and lead three new ads with it.
All 21 of your ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so nothing explains why a product is worth stopping for. Write three story ads: a real wearer in sizes 36 to 54, and a fit tip.
None of your ads mention an offer or discount, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Put one reason to buy now, a first order offer or a bundle, in line one of three new ads.
21 ads have run 60 days or more and 11 from June 2025 still run, so you already have proven winners to build from. Make three variations of the oldest one, each with new copy and a new image.
